title: Base map 2017
description: The 2017 national topographic base map contains 12,127,863 features merged from 87 WFS layers. Filter by `layer_name`. Coordinates remain in MOLDREF99 / Moldova TM (EPSG:4026).
description:en: The 2017 national topographic base map contains 12,127,863 features merged from 87 WFS layers. Filter by `layer_name`. Coordinates remain in MOLDREF99 / Moldova TM (EPSG:4026).
description:ro: Harta topografică națională de bază 2017 conține 12,127,863 entități reunite din 87 straturi WFS. Filtrați după `layer_name`. Coordonatele rămân în MOLDREF99 / Moldova TM (EPSG:4026).
description:ru: Национальная топографическая базовая карта 2017 года содержит 12,127,863 объектов, объединённых из 87 слоёв WFS. Фильтруйте по `layer_name`. Координаты сохранены в MOLDREF99 / Moldova TM (EPSG:4026).

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.description: Bounding box struct written by the extractor for spatial pruning.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: MOLDREF99 / Moldova TM (EPSG:4026), projected, in metres.

table:columns.name: gid
table:columns.description: Source row identifier, unique within the originating WFS layer and not across layers.

table:columns.name: layer
table:columns.description: CAD layer code. The source publishes no code list, so the values are carried undecoded.

table:columns.name: layer_name
table:columns.description: Feature class, such as fence, roof_area, or contour_line. This is the column to filter on.

table:columns.name: medium
table:columns.description: Source-coded medium flag. No code list is published.

table:columns.name: shape_leng
table:columns.description: Length in metres, present on the line layers only.

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: The WFS layer this row was extracted from, so the merge can be reversed.

table:columns.name: z
table:columns.description: Elevation in metres, from the source survey.

providers.name: Agenția Geodezie, Cartografie și Cadastru (AGCC)
providers.description: Autoritatea națională pentru geodezie, cartografie și cadastru. Operator tehnic: Î.S. INGEOCAD.

data-area.title: Base map 2017, area geometries, merged from 6 source layers

data-point.title: Base map 2017, point geometries, merged from 17 source layers

partition:keys.name: kdtree_cell
partition:keys.description: Spatial cell from a k-d tree split of the line geometries, so a reader can prune files by extent without opening them.
